notes: Suite result: 37 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Mutation 1 (removing the marker substring test from extract_r1) turned Z1 and Z4 RED (Z3 stayed green). Both mutations were reverted immediately; git diff on the script confirmed byte-identical to the Phase 1 commit afterward.
